controls.bloomToggleHint: Soft glow that spreads from bright areas (bloom).
controls.bloomThresholdHint: Only pixels brighter than this level contribute strongly to the glow.
controls.halationToggleHint: Colored glow around very bright edges (halation).
controls.artifactsSectionHint: Grain, vignette, glow, halation, and related film-look controls.
controls.sourceTrimSectionHint: Adjust the imported image before the film look—exposure, color, highlights, and shadows.
controls.compressionHint: Softens bright tones with a film-style shoulder curve. Not file or data compression.
controls.compressionRangeHint: Widens or narrows how much of the tonal range that softness affects (highlights through shadows).
controls.printContrastHint: Adds contrast in the print-style stage—separate from the main Contrast slider in the grading stack.
controls.grainRadialMixHint: Near 0: even grain. Near 1: stronger toward frame edges (not chromatic aberration). At 1 matches the previous default.
controls.lightShaftsToggleHint: Volumetric beams of light radiating from a point in the frame.
controls.shaftIntensityHint: Overall brightness of the light shafts. Zero means off.
controls.shaftDecayHint: How quickly the beams fade as they spread from the source.
controls.shaftOriginXHint: Horizontal position of the light source (0 = left, 1 = right).
controls.shaftOriginYHint: Vertical position of the light source (0 = top, 1 = bottom).
controls.dustAmountHint: Adds random dust particles over the image, like aged film stock.
controls.scratchAmountHint: Adds vertical film scratches that drift across the frame.
controls.motionBlurAmountHint: Blends the previous frame into the current one, creating a trailing afterimage.

app.subtitle: Desktop — export from a folder
app.tabBatchAria: Export tab — save photos or video from a folder
app.sendGradeCaption: Sends slider values only to the Export tab. LUT via JSON, etc.

app.sendGradeTipAria: Note when sending grade to Export

batch.tipExportTabIntro: Photos in a folder can be saved in bulk to another folder with your Filmtone look. You can also export one video as MP4 with the same look. After adjusting sliders on Edit, use “Send grade to Export” (bottom right) to copy values here. LUTs are separate (e.g. load JSON).
batch.tipJobImages: Every .jpg / .jpeg / .png in the chosen folder gets this look, saved as JPEG or PNG to another folder.
batch.tipJobVideoFastOption: Default is fast one-pass ffmpeg (approximate). Turn on step-by-step WebGL only if you want a closer match to the preview. .cube LUT is preferred; Params are approximated in ffmpeg — lutIntensity, bloom, halation, and split-tone details may not match. ffmpeg and ffprobe must be on PATH.
batch.tipJobVideoWebGlOnly: Only WebGL frame-by-frame export (slower) for a closer preview match. Fast one-pass ffmpeg is being prepared and hidden from the UI. ffmpeg and ffprobe must be on PATH.
batch.tipSourcesImagesFolder: Only .jpg / .jpeg / .png in that folder (not subfolders by default in UI copy). Not for video conversion.
batch.tipSourcesVideoFile: Import limit: up to 4K and max {maxSec}s. ffmpeg and ffprobe must be on PATH.
batch.tipLookJsonDetails: Use when passing or saving a full look (including LUT) as a file. Usually “Send grade to Export” or preset is enough.
batch.tipApplyEditGradeToBatch: Copies slider and tone values from Edit into this export (same as “Send grade to Export”). After changing preset, preset values apply until you sync. LUT (.cube) is not copied here — use “Advanced: Grade JSON” below.
batch.tipFilenameSuffix: Inserted before the extension. Example: -graded → IMG0001-graded.jpg. Empty = no suffix. Use a different folder than sources to avoid overwriting.
batch.tipVideoOutputNaming: Output file name is original stem + -graded.mp4. Max output FHD · {fps} fps.
batch.tipWebglAccurate: When on, seeks each frame and grades via readPixels — very slow but closest to Edit. Off (default) uses fast ffmpeg one-pass (approximate). .cube LUT preferred; Params approximated in ffmpeg.
batch.tipKeyboardShortcuts: ⌘1 / ⌘2 (Ctrl on Windows) switch tabs. On Export, ⌘↵ runs “{imagesLabel}” or “Export video”. ⇧⌘↵ retries failed items only (photos). ⇧⌘Y resumes. Esc cancels.
batch.tipDesktopPrefsPersist: Input/output folders become defaults next time (existing paths). Window position and size are saved on quit.
batch.tipResumeSession: Continue with saved I/O and look for remaining frames only. Discard removes the record only — already exported files stay on disk.

desktopExportWorkflow033.title: Desktop v0.3 — export & preview refinement
desktopExportWorkflow033.description: Clearer switching between photo batch export and single-video export, fewer mistakes bridging the graded preview into export defaults, aligned edit/export chrome, a searchable preset picker, and automatic video preview pause while export is busy.

webFilmLabPreview033.title: Web demo preview tuning (v0.3)
webFilmLabPreview033.description: Adjusted preview sizing and media presentation in the browser demo for a closer match to Desktop.

desktopFilmProcess040.title: Desktop v0.4 — film process controls
desktopFilmProcess040.description: Compression, compression range, print contrast, and cyan / magenta / yellow trim — aligned between the browser demo preview and Desktop export.

quickProFilmStock040.title: Quick / Pro layout and Film Stock picker (v0.4)
quickProFilmStock040.description: Quick stays on the shortest path; Pro exposes process, artifacts, source trim, and LUT in order. Preset surfaces group film stocks with clearer boundaries (including stocks like Velvia 50).

videoTransport042.title: Video preview transport (v0.4.2)
videoTransport042.description: Play/pause, timeline scrub, timecode, and Space to toggle playback on Web and Desktop — with locks during export or preview hold, and safe interaction alongside Compare mode.

proPanelVocabulary042.title: Pro panel vocabulary & inline hints (v0.4.2)
proPanelVocabulary042.description: Clearer Pro labels (film texture, source adjustments, color fringing), improved Japanese for Bloom/Halation, hover hints on collapsible headers, and a Bloom threshold tooltip.

fasterVideoExport043.title: Faster export for heavy codec sources (v0.4.3)
fasterVideoExport043.description: 4K HEVC and other heavy format sources are automatically optimized before export, delivering up to 4× faster throughput.

presetExpansion.title: Preset expansion
presetExpansion.description: Additional film stocks and creative looks beyond the initial four.

releaseNotes.heroBody: A log of every Desktop release, from the initial launch onward. Each entry covers what was added, fixed, or changed.

entries.v045BloomHalationRework: Bloom and halation effects completely redesigned — smoother glow spread, precise highlight targeting, and graceful behavior at any slider setting. Existing projects may look slightly different.
entries.v045PresetRecalibration: All 10 film stock presets recalibrated for more accurate and natural bloom and halation behavior.
entries.v044ProresLoadAndExport: ProRes MOV files (LOG footage) can now be previewed and exported. The source is automatically converted to an optimized format on import.
entries.v044Dci4kInput: DCI 4K (4096×2160) and other above-UHD resolutions are now accepted as video input.
entries.v043Title: Faster video export for heavy sources
entries.v043FasterHevcExport: Up to 4× faster export for 4K HEVC sources, cutting a 3-minute encode to under 45 seconds.
entries.v043AutoSourceOptimize: Heavy codec sources (HEVC, VP9, AV1, ProRes) are automatically optimized before grading. H.264 sources skip this step and export at full speed.
entries.v043OptimizationProgress: A progress bar appears during source optimization so exports of heavy files don't look stalled.
entries.v042Title: Pro panel vocabulary pass—textures, glow, source, and fringing
entries.v042ProPanelVocabulary: Renamed several Pro labels for clarity (e.g. Artifacts → Film texture, Source Trim → Source adjustments, RGB Shift → Color fringing). Japanese UI uses plainer words for Bloom/Halation and the source block.
entries.v042BloomThresholdHint: Bloom’s threshold slider now includes a short tooltip explaining which brightness levels drive the glow.
entries.v042VideoTransport: Video preview: play/pause, timeline scrub, timecode, and Space to toggle — controls lock during export or preview hold.
entries.v041Title: Clearer Pro Tone labels and slider tooltips
entries.v041ProToneLabels: Pro section Process is now Tone, with friendlier slider names (highlight softness, tone span, print snap) and short hover explanations on Web and Desktop. Japanese labels avoid awkward line breaks.
entries.v041SliderTooltipReset: Film Lab sliders combine control-specific tips with a localized “tap label to reset” hint.
entries.v040Title: Film process controls, Quick / Pro refresh, and picker polish
entries.v040FilmProcess: Added film process controls — compression, range, print contrast, and CMY trim — with Web preview and Desktop export staying in sync.
entries.v040QuickProIa: Reorganized Quick (shortest path) vs Pro (process, artifacts, source trim, LUT) so the panel matches how people work.
entries.v040FilmStockPicker: Film Stock surfaces use category grouping so presets like Velvia 50 are easier to find alongside cinematic and reset options.
entries.v040PanelStability: Desktop keeps the control panel mounted across tab switches so photo preview no longer drops process settings unexpectedly.
entries.v040ShareCompat: Shared URLs and import/export paths stay backward compatible while carrying the new process fields when present.
entries.v031Title: Beta browser video export and Desktop reliability fixes
entries.v031WebVideoExportBeta: Added beta graded video export in the browser so short clips can be tested without leaving the web experience.
entries.v031WebBrowserReliability: Improved browser export reliability and added clearer Safari guidance, with Chrome, Edge, or Filmtone Desktop recommended when needed.
entries.v031FinderThumb: Fixed a black-thumbnail issue where graded MP4 exports could look broken in Finder or Quick Look even though playback was fine.
entries.v031MovHandling: Improved video import fallback for files whose MIME type is missing or unreliable, including MOV-style inputs.
entries.v030Title: Desktop workflow refinement and clearer export
entries.v030ExportIa: Clearer separation between photo batch export and single-video export — top tabs, overlay panel, and toolbar reduce guesswork.
entries.v030ExportSource: The preview you are grading is bridged into export as the default input where appropriate, reducing wrong-file mistakes.
entries.v030VisualPolish: Export chrome and edit mode are visually aligned for less context switching.
entries.v030PresetSearch: Searchable preset picker — jump to a look without scanning the full list.
entries.v030ExportBusyPause: Video preview pauses automatically while export is busy so on-screen state matches the pipeline.
entries.v030WebPreview: Browser demo preview height and media presentation tuned for a cleaner, more Desktop-like view.
entries.v020Title: Dual LUT, redesigned export, and faster video
entries.v020DualLut: Apply two LUT files simultaneously — Slot 1 for input transforms (e.g. Log-to-Rec709), Slot 2 for creative looks, each with independent intensity.
entries.v020LutSync: LUT files from the Edit tab now sync to export. A 3-state button shows whether your grade is synced, out-of-sync, or partially synced.
entries.v020InlineExportPanel: Export moved from a multi-step wizard to an inline accordion — canvas stays visible, frosted glass UI integrates with macOS titlebar.
entries.v020WebCodecsReEnabled: WebCodecs video export re-enabled with hardware decoder preference, PBO readback, and correct BT.709 color space.
entries.v020UpdateNotify: In-app update notification — a banner appears when a newer version is available.
entries.v020PackageRefactor: Internal restructuring into 4 packages (core, renderer, ui, smart-look) for cleaner code separation.
entries.v013FrameLogSuppression: Suppressed per-frame log output during video export for cleaner console and improved performance.
entries.v012VideoColorShift: Fixed color shift in video export caused by the WebCodecs pipeline path.
entries.v011FfmpegPath: Fixed ffmpeg / ffprobe path resolution in the packaged (DMG) distribution.
entries.v010BatchExport: Batch JPEG / PNG grading — apply a preset to an entire folder at once.
entries.v010VideoExport: Single short video export with the same grade baked in.
entries.v010FourPresets: Four film-inspired presets: Kodak Portra 400, Fuji Pro 400H, Kodak Ektar 100, Ilford HP5 Plus.
entries.v010BrowserDemo: Browser demo — try presets on your own photos before downloading.
